title: YouTube Shopping at 500 subs
subtitle: Who can join, how it pays, and the catch
sections: YouTube Partner Program channels from 500 subscribers (since 27 Mar 2026).
Eligible countries only: 12 at launch, 15 by Aug 2026 (UK added 6 Aug), target 35 by end of 2026.
Not for music channels or made-for-kids channels.
Tag products in videos, Shorts and lives.
Each brand sets its own commission per product.
Paid through AdSense 60-120 days after purchase; returns reverse the commission.
1.3M+ creators enrolled (YouTube, Sep 2026), up from 500,000 in Jul 2025.
steps: Check YPP status in YouTube Studio > Earn.
Turn on Shopping and pick products you already use.
Tag them where you really talk about them, and disclose.
